notes: You don't start with everyone's number anymore. Swap numbers with someone while you're with them (Messages → Swap numbers), or they can give you theirs in the story. Only contacts can text, call or invite you, and only they show on the Map.
Phone profile pictures: set one for each character in the creator, and one for yourself in Personas. You can also tap any contact's picture in a chat to give them your own contact photo.
New worlds: choose whether you already have each other's numbers.
